verdict.rationale: Community Phone documents two-way SMS on its Business Plus plan, but only through the dashboard and mobile app. Nothing in the pack shows a developer API for sending or receiving SMS, or delivery-status callbacks, and every OpenAPI/Swagger path probed returned 404. App-based texting is an adjacent feature and does not deliver the programmatic story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send and receive SMS on the number through the API with delivery status callbacks
